title: Click-Clack Cuttlefish
statement: Nestled in indigo water among sunken brass astrolabes and velvety emerald moss, this pint-sized cephalopod spends its days meticulously sorting colorful sea-glass into intricate, ever-changing mosaics. Whenever a curious visitor leans close, its translucent skin ripples with warm golden constellations as it cheerfully taps its two favorite pebbles together.
